info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Investment Management Investment Portfolio Analysis-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Analysis API provides insights into investment portfolios, allowing users to evaluate the performance and status of their assets. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of comprehensive data related to various investment portfolios, aiding financial analysts and investment managers in making informed decisions. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and investment firms that require real-time analysis of portfolios to optimize their investment strategies. Utilize this API to enhance your investment management capabilities and drive better financial outcomes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed analysis of their investment portfolio, providing insights and metrics to help evaluate performance and make informed investment decisions.

requestBody.description: The request body for analyzing investment portfolios. This should contain the necessary parameters required for the analysis process, formatted as per the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning portfolio analysis data.
